expectedItems.name: Prescribed pain medicine
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Take the prescribed pain medicine after meals as directed.

expectedItems.name: Low-fat diet
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Follow a low-fat diet for the first week and eat smaller meals.

expectedItems.name: Gentle walking
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Walk gently every day and avoid strenuous activity for 2 weeks.

expectedItems.name: Worsening abdominal pain
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Contact the hospital for fever, worsening abdominal pain, yellowing of the eyes, or persistent vomiting.
